caption:
When you have no strength left to hold this weight — power is for standing, not escaping. (1 Timothy 1:12 devotional)

"How long can someone like me keep holding this up?" Paul thanks the One who *enabled* him — not the One who excused him from his place.

His power doesn't remove the storm. It keeps you from collapsing inside it. God didn't stop the rain; He kept Paul standing in it.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
